newsitem.title: USA: U.S. rig count up 12 at 999 in week.
newsitem.headline: U.S. rig count up 12 at 999 in week.

text.p: The number of rigs exploring for oil and natural gas in the United States stood at 999 as of August 15, up 12 from the prior week and 194 above the year-ago total of 805, Baker Hughes Inc reported.
The number of rigs drilling on land rose by 10 to 848, while rigs working offshore rose to at 125. The number of rigs active in inland waters rose to 26.
Among the individual states, the biggest changes occurred in Texas, which was up by 19, Oklahoma, which was down by 6, and Louisiana, which was up by four.
The Gulf of Mexico rig count rose to 121.

A total of 417 rigs were exploring for crude oil, down 12 from last week. The number of rigs searching for gas rose by 25 to 580, while the number of miscellaneous drilling projects now stands at two , down by one from last week..
There were 238 rigs drilling directionally, 67 drilling horizontally and 694 drilling vertically.
In Canada, the number of working rigs fell by 14 to 406, versus 261 one year ago.
The weekly rig count reflects the number of rigs exploring for oil and gas, not those producing oil and gas.
